scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
scripts.restart: bun run down && bun run up && bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed && bun run dev
scripts.up: docker compose -p job-tracker -f infra/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans postgres redis mailpit
scripts.down: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose -p job-tracker -f infra/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.check: bun run db:check && bun run redis:check && bun run mailpit:check
scripts.db:up: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans postgres
scripts.db:down: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop postgres
scripts.db:check: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U xeniway -d xeniway
scripts.redis:up: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans redis
scripts.redis:down: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop redis
scripts.redis:check: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T redis redis-cli ping
scripts.mailpit:up: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans mailpit
scripts.mailpit:down: docker compose -p xeniway -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop mailpit
